title: census.py dispatch grants no Learn fetch tool to a memdocs pin row whose brief tells the reader to re-source to the live Learn page
goal: dispatch_plan puts a raw-pin or gh-pin row whose note is memdocs in plan[learn], so the session's allow rules hold the Learn fetch tool and its --mcp-config; a dispatched reader of such a row no longer answers unconfirmed with 'microsoft_docs_fetch is not available in this run'

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import census; r={'id':'S1','kind':'raw-pin','repo':'MicrosoftDocs/memdocs','pin':'a'*40,'path':'x.md','evidence':'','proof':'','note':'memdocs','url':'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MicrosoftDocs/memdocs/'+'a'*40+'/x.md'}; p=census.dispatch_plan('g',[(r,{},{})],{'providers':[]}); sys.exit(0 if p['learn']==['S1'] else 1)
